title.en: AN ACT ANNEXING THE BARRIO OF EGUIA, OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF SAN ISIDRO, TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF INFANTA, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF PANGASINAN.
title.orig: AN ACT ANNEXING THE BARRIO OF EGUIA, OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF SAN ISIDRO, TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF INFANTA, BOTH IN THE PROVINCE OF PANGASINAN.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_01254_1904_html.txt

text.en:
The barrio of Eguia, now a part of the municipality of San Isidro, Province of Pangasinan, is
hereby annexed to and consolidated with the municipality of Infanta, in the same province.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, October 26, 1904.
